board.agent.agentBusy.text: {agent} {status, select, working {is working} starting {is starting} waiting {is waiting for the user} background {is waiting on background tasks it started} other {is waiting on cards (a card watch): it takes no other work until it is woken, or the watch is cancelled (Cancel in its header)}}. Start the task once it's idle, or give it to another agent.
board.agent.agentBusy.note: #910: the words the Agent API always gave (the window says card). status: what the agent is doing (working, starting, waiting, background; other: a card watch).

board.agent.chooseProject.text: Choose a project before giving the task to an agent.
board.agent.chooseProject.note: #910: the words the Agent API always gave (the window says card).

board.agent.needsTitle.note: #910: the words the Agent API always gave (the window says card).

board.agent.unknownTask.note: #910: the words the Agent API always gave (the window says card). Also what a confined agent is told about a card outside its project.

board.error.inUse.text: Another Hive has this workspace open: close it first.
board.error.inUse.note: An error: the board can't be upgraded to 1.0 (or its 0.9 backup put back) while another copy of Hive (an older version, or another profile) has the workspace open. Nothing was changed.

board.error.newer.text: This board was saved by a newer version of Hive. It is shown read-only: update Hive to change it.
board.error.newer.note: An error: the workspace's task board was saved by a newer Hive, whose format this version doesn't know; cards can be read but not changed.

board.error.noBackup.text: There is no 0.9 board backup to put back: this board was never upgraded to 1.0 here.
board.error.noBackup.note: An error from Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup…: no copy of the board from before its upgrade to Hive 1.0 is kept in the workspace.

board.error.noWorkspace.note: An error: the task board needs an open workspace, and there is none.

board.error.stopAgentsFirst.text: Stop this workspace's agents and its Assistant first: once the 0.9 board is back, Hive can't record them.
board.error.stopAgentsFirst.note: An error from Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup…: agents of the workspace are running or starting; the board put back is read-only in this Hive, so their sessions couldn't be recorded. Nothing was changed.

board.error.unavailable.note: An error: the workspace's task board database couldn't be opened or its cards couldn't be moved into it; {error} says why (from the system, often in English). Nothing was lost: the cards are still where they were.

board.error.upgradeFirst.text: This board is from Hive 0.9: it is read-only until it is upgraded to 1.0 (Upgrade… on the board's banner).
board.error.upgradeFirst.note: An error: the workspace's task board hasn't been upgraded to Hive 1.0's format yet (the user was asked and said not now), so cards can be read but not changed. Upgrade… is the button on the banner above the board.

board.error.upgradeFirstStart.text: This workspace is from Hive 0.9: upgrade it to 1.0 before starting agents (Upgrade… on the banner at the top of the window).
board.error.upgradeFirstStart.note: An error: an agent (or the Assistant) can't start while the workspace's data waits for its upgrade to Hive 1.0's format (the user said Not Now): Hive couldn't record its session. Upgrade… is the button on the banner at the top of the window.
